claims.statement: The CLI introduction describes bringing pull requests, issues, Actions and other features to the terminal. The rhetorical all-work-in-one-place benefit is not exhaustive feature parity, actual authentication, implemented operational bindings or permission to mutate every feature.
The learn-more note links to the parent about-CLI article. It supplies no additional behavior or prerequisite and does not inherit review of the linked page.

Copilot CLI feedback uses an interactive feedback slash command with private survey, bug report or feature suggestion choices. These are optional external submissions; private labeling is not a reviewed confidentiality guarantee, informed data-sharing consent or authority to send workspace information. No feedback was submitted.

CLI issue/PR filtering is a capability with manual links for issue list and PR list. A filtered result is not the complete issue/PR population, verified pagination or evidence that omitted entries are absent; external manuals remain separate evidence.

The pinned note labels Copilot local sandboxes public-preview and subject to change. The label does not establish availability, enabled isolation, permitted paths, escape resistance or permission to execute untrusted code.
